details.flavorMarkdown: *An articulated skeleton armed with a rusted sword and remnants of an old uniform. No appetite or fatigue distracts it from the narrow command that holds its bones together.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Old sword

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares.

**Signs:** Dry clicking answers footsteps in an otherwise silent hall.

**Purpose:** Repeat the last clear command it was given.

**Tactics and retreat:** Block the doorway and strike intruders who cross the boundary.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Learn the command or approach from a route its orders did not cover.

**Habitat:** Crypt; ruin · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Ordinary melee weapon; no coins.

**Summoning:** Undead 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/summons/bone-sentry.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-bone-sentry


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Guard · **CV:** 7

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/5

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.0

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=2.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md).
